commands.name: Initialize Repository
commands.description: Create a new Git repository in the current directory.

commands.name: Clone Repository
commands.description: Download an existing repository (and its history) from a remote URL.

commands.name: Set User Name
commands.description: Configure the name Git associates with your commits.

commands.name: Set User Email
commands.description: Configure the email Git associates with your commits.

commands.name: Check Status
commands.description: Show modified, staged, and untracked files.

commands.name: Stage File
commands.description: Add file changes to the staging area in preparation for a commit.

commands.name: Commit
commands.description: Create a new commit from staged changes with a short message.

commands.name: Amend Commit
commands.description: Modify the most recent commit (message and staged content).

commands.name: List Branches
commands.description: List all local branches and highlight the current one.

commands.name: Create Branch
commands.description: Create a new branch pointer at the current commit.

commands.name: Switch Branch
commands.description: Move HEAD to another branch (or create it with -c).

commands.name: Delete Branch
commands.description: Remove a merged branch reference locally.

commands.name: Add Remote
commands.description: Connect the local repository to a remote named origin.

commands.name: Fetch Updates
commands.description: Download new commits and refs from the remote without merging.

commands.name: Pull
commands.description: Fetch and merge remote changes into the current branch.

commands.name: Push
commands.description: Upload local commits to the remote repository.

commands.name: Merge Branch
commands.description: Combine another branch's commits into the current branch.

commands.name: Rebase
commands.description: Replay commits from the current branch onto another base.

commands.name: Abort Merge/Rebase
commands.description: Stop the current merge and reset to the pre-merge state.

commands.name: Continue Rebase
commands.description: Resume an interactive rebase after resolving conflicts.

commands.name: Stash Changes
commands.description: Temporarily store dirty working tree changes.

commands.name: List Stashes
commands.description: Show all stashed snapshots.

commands.name: Apply Stash
commands.description: Reapply a stash to the working tree and keep it in the list.

commands.name: Drop Stash
commands.description: Remove a stash entry from the stash list.

commands.name: View Log
commands.description: Inspect commit history with a compact graph view.

commands.name: Show Differences
commands.description: Display unstaged changes between working tree and index.

commands.name: Blame
commands.description: Show commit author and time for each line of a file.

commands.name: Show Commit
commands.description: Inspect a specific commit (metadata and diff).
